MEASUREMENT / PROCESS / EVIDENCE: 测量 / 过程 / 证据
Investigate sensor integrity and compare: 检查测量完整性，比较基于物理约束的故障解释。
Investigate sensor integrity and compare physical fault explanations.
Import a dataset or save a simulation to: 导入数据集或保存模拟后开始。
Import a dataset or save a simulation to begin.
I declare this reference interval to be: 我声明此参考区间为正常运行。
I declare this reference interval to be normal operation.
The reference needs at least max(90, 3 ×: 参考区间至少需要 max(90, 3 × 窗口) 个样本。按时间顺序使用前 70% 拟合、后 30% 校准阈值。
The reference needs at least max(90, 3 × window) samples. Thresholds use a chronological 70% fit / 30% calibration split.
Integrity and declared relationships onl: 仅完整性与显式信号关系
Signal mapping and nominal physical para: 信号映射与标称物理参数
Signal mapping and nominal physical parameters
Use independent flow measurements and kn: 使用独立流量测量与已知几何参数。诊断不使用模拟器的故障标签、起点和强度。
Use independent flow measurements and known geometry. Simulator fault labels, onset and severity are excluded.
尚无已保存的传感器诊断。
Select simulation to save as dataset: 选择模拟并保存为数据集
Select simulation to save as dataset
Agreement compares redundant measurement: 一致性检查先用正常数据校准冗余测量的偏置，线性预测使用参考区间拟合。仅凭关系违背无法确定哪个通道故障。
Agreement compares redundant measurements after normal offset calibration. Linear prediction is fitted on the reference. Neither identifies the faulty channel alone.
Expected from related measurements: 由相关测量推算的预期值
Severity is statistic / threshold; value: 严重度为统计量 / 阈值，大于 1 表示超限。
Severity is statistic / threshold; values above 1 indicate an exceedance.
Fault timeline and competing explanation: 故障时间线与竞争解释
Rankings compare residual corrections un: 排序比较单故障假设下的残差修正效果。拟合分数不是因果概率。
Rankings compare residual corrections under a single-fault assumption. Fit scores are not causal probabilities.
No diagnostic threshold exceedances in t: 所选区间没有诊断统计量超限。
No diagnostic threshold exceedances in the selected interval.
Saved reference and reproducibility: 已保存的参考与复现信息
Saved sensor diagnostic evidence; candid: 已保存传感器诊断证据，候选解释仍需进一步调查确认。
Saved sensor diagnostic evidence; candidate explanations require investigation.
hydraulic1: 水箱 1 液位与流量关系残差
hydraulic2: 水箱 2 液位与流量关系残差
balance1: 水箱 1 质量平衡残差
balance2: 水箱 2 质量平衡残差
insufficient_evidence: 证据不足或解释不唯一
level1_offset: 水箱 1 液位测量偏置
level2_offset: 水箱 2 液位测量偏置
level1_drift: 水箱 1 液位传感器漂移
level2_drift: 水箱 2 液位传感器漂移
level1_integrity: 水箱 1 液位测量完整性故障
level2_integrity: 水箱 2 液位测量完整性故障
integrity_is_not_causality: 单信号异常不能证明传感器故障，真实过程变化也可能产生相同指示。
A single-signal anomaly does not prove sensor failure; real process changes can produce the same indicators.
normal_reference_required: 参考区间必须为有代表性的正常实测数据。偏置已存在于参考区间时可能无法辨识。
The reference must contain representative normal measurements. Bias already present in the reference may be unidentifiable.
single_fault_assumption: 每个区间按一个主要故障比较；多个同时故障可能导致证据不足。
Each interval compares one dominant fault; simultaneous faults can yield insufficient evidence.
no_physical_model: 未提供物理模型，完整性和关系检查不进行过程因果归因。
Without a physical model, integrity and relationship checks do not assign process causes.
known_tank_parameters: 假定水箱几何参数和标称泵、阀及出口系数已知且稳定。
Tank geometry and nominal pump, valve and outlet coefficients are assumed known and stable.
independent_flow_measurements: 假定流量测量独立且可信；共享故障或由液位计算的流量会破坏隔离依据。
Flow measurements are assumed independent and trustworthy; shared faults or level-derived flows invalidate isolation evidence.
valve_change_ambiguity: 阀门受限与有意改变开度仅凭这些测量无法区分。
These measurements cannot distinguish valve restriction from a deliberate opening change.
unsaturated_tanks: 仅在非空、未溢流的水箱条件下使用此物理诊断，缺失和采集间隙使窗口重置。
Physical diagnosis requires nonempty tanks below overflow; missing values and acquisition gaps reset evidence windows.
constant_reference: 正常参考近似常数，无法据此判定后续恒定读数为冻结。
The normal reference is constant; later constant readings alone cannot establish a frozen sensor.
acquisition_gaps: 存在采集时间间隙，窗口已重置且不插值补齐。
Acquisition gaps reset windows; missing times are not interpolated.
A level shift can be a sensor offset or: 信号偏移可能由测量偏置或真实过程变化引起。
A level shift can be a sensor offset or a real process change.
A sustained local slope requires cross-s: 持续的局部斜率需要跨信号证据辅助隔离。
A sustained local slope requires cross-signal evidence for isolation.
Local linear detrending removes ramps, b: 局部线性去趋势可去除斜坡，但过程振荡也可能增大该统计量。
Local linear detrending removes ramps, but process oscillations can also increase this statistic.
Processed values count as unavailable me: 处理填充值不计入可用实测证据。
Processed values count as unavailable measured evidence.
Disagreement identifies a relationship v: 不一致表示信号关系被违背，不能单独确定故障通道。
Disagreement identifies a relationship violation, not which channel failed.
Sensor diagnostic belongs to a different: 传感器诊断属于另一个工作区。
Sensor diagnostic belongs to a different workspace.
Choose an existing diagnostic fault inte: 请选择已有的诊断故障区间。
Choose an existing diagnostic fault interval.
Sensor health configuration must be an o: 传感器健康配置必须是对象。
Sensor health configuration must be an object.
Select 1–24 unique sensor signals from t: 请从数据集中选择 1–24 个不同的传感器信号。
Select 1–24 unique sensor signals from this dataset.
Sensor health supports 90–50,000 timesta: 单次传感器诊断支持 90–50,000 行带时间戳数据。
Sensor health supports 90–50,000 timestamped rows per run.
Sensor health requires strictly increasi: 诊断需要严格递增且唯一的时间戳，请先处理重复时间。
Sensor health requires strictly increasing unique timestamps; resolve duplicates first.
The diagnostic threshold multiplier must: 诊断阈值倍数必须介于 3 到 12。
The diagnostic threshold multiplier must be between 3 and 12.
Choose valid reference and analysis inte: 请选择数据范围内有效的参考和诊断区间。
Choose valid reference and analysis intervals inside the dataset.
Use a normal reference of at least max(9: 正常参考须严格早于诊断区间，至少包含 max(90, 3 × 窗口) 个样本；诊断区间须至少包含一个窗口。
Use a normal reference of at least max(90, 3 × window) samples strictly before the analysis interval; analyze at least one window.
Use at most eight declared signal relati: 最多声明八组信号关系。
Use at most eight declared signal relationships.
Declare agreement or linear relationship: 请在两个不同的已选信号间声明一致性或线性关系。
Declare agreement or linear relationships between two distinct selected signals.
A declared relationship needs 30 paired: 信号关系需要至少 30 个配对正常拟合样本。
A declared relationship needs 30 paired normal fit observations.
A declared relationship needs 20 paired: 信号关系需要至少 20 个配对正常校准样本。
A declared relationship needs 20 paired normal calibration observations.
Linear relationships need an excited pre: 线性关系的预测信号在正常参考区间必须有变化。
Linear relationships need an excited predictor in the normal reference.
Choose the supported coupled-tanks model: 请选择耦合水箱模型并显式配置映射和物理参数。
Choose the supported coupled-tanks model with explicit signal mapping and physical parameters.
Map all seven tank roles to distinct sel: 请将七个水箱角色映射到不同的已选实测信号。
Map all seven tank roles to distinct selected measured signals.
Only declared geometry and nominal hydra: 诊断仅接受声明的几何与标称水力参数，不接受故障标签。
Only declared geometry and nominal hydraulic parameters are diagnostic inputs; fault labels are prohibited.
Tank geometry and nominal coefficients m: 水箱几何参数和标称系数须为不大于 100 的有限正数。
Tank geometry and nominal coefficients must be finite and positive, at most 100.
Tank diagnosis requires paired, unsatura: 水箱诊断参考区间需要 30 个拟合及 20 个校准样本，所有测量须配对且水箱未空或溢流。
Tank diagnosis requires paired, unsaturated reference measurements for 30 fit and 20 calibration samples.
{0}: reference needs 30 measured fit and: {0}：参考区间需要 30 个实测拟合值和 20 个实测校准值。
{0}: reference needs 30 measured fit and 20 measured calibration values.
{0} is outside the supported integer ran: {0} is outside the supported integer range {1}–{2}.
Use only declared sensor diagnostic sett: 仅接受已声明的诊断配置，不接受模拟器故障标签。
Use only declared sensor diagnostic settings; simulator labels are not accepted.
Levels: m · flows: m³/s · pump command:: 液位：m · 流量：m³/s · 泵指令：% · 开度：比例。单位不匹配时请先在数据变换中转换。
Levels: m · flows: m³/s · pump command: % · opening: fraction. Convert incompatible units in Transformations first.

Redundant agreement requires matching units; convert signals in Transformations first.
Convert tank levels to m, flows to m³/s,: 诊断前请将液位转换为 m，流量转换为 m³/s，泵指令转换为 %，开度转换为比例。
Convert tank levels to m, flows to m³/s, pump command to %, and opening to fraction before diagnosis.
